test_title: PYST 21: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 09 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word from the following sentence.**

Ambitious

He aspires to be a future diplomat but he will have to improve his decision-making skills.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Aspires**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word '**ambitious**' means having a strong desire to succeed or achieve something. (सफल होने या कुछ हासिल करने की तीव्र इच्छा होना)

 
 
• **Example**: *Despite challenges, she remained ambitious and pursued her career goals.*
 
 
 
• The word '**aspires**' is a synonym of 'ambitious' and means to have a strong desire or hope to achieve something. (कुछ हासिल करने की प्रबल इच्छा या आशा होना)
 
 
• **Example**: *As a talented artist, he aspires to showcase his work in renowned galleries.*
 
 
 
• In the given sentence, the person mentioned wants to become a diplomat in the future, which shows his ambition or strong desire to succeed.
 
• Therefore, the word 'aspires' is the most appropriate synonym for 'ambitious' in this context.

Thus, **option 1** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Improve **means to make something better or to enhance its quality. (किसी चीज़ को बेहतर बनाना या उसकी गुणवत्ता बढ़ाना)
 
• **Decision **means a choice or judgement made after consideration or deliberation. (विचार या विचार-विमर्श के बाद किया गया कोई विकल्प या निर्णय)
 
• **Skills **mean the ability to do something well, usually gained through training or experience. (कुछ अच्छा करने की क्षमता, आमतौर पर प्रशिक्षण या अनुभव के माध्यम से प्राप्त की जाती है)
